stage26_4c3_measurement_caveat.issue: The Stage26-4C3 implementation performs full-array output integrity/fingerprint reading outside the timed region between timed iterations. Although excluded from each timer window, those reads may perturb cache/CPU state before subsequent timed iterations.
stage26_4c3_measurement_caveat.stage26_7_policy: Use the durable 4C3 point estimates as measured, retain the caveat in component-capacity interpretation, and do not silently replace or rerun the measurement.
stage26_4c3_measurement_caveat.stage26_8_required_action: Explicitly audit/report the inter-iteration integrity-read sensitivity and, if a prospective cleaner implementation sensitivity run is performed, preserve 4C3 as the original measurement rather than overwriting it.
